quotes.speaker: Brian Windhorst
quotes.summary_phrase: 76ers' early season success in clutch situations
quotes.excerpt: Philly is 6-1. All six wins are clutch time wins.
quotes.quote: Philly is 6-1. All six wins are clutch time wins. If you go under the hood and try to figure out why they are winning these close games, obviously they have really good players, but LeBron James and Joel Embiid did not play on Saturday. They don't turn the ball over. They are first in fewest turnovers in the league and they defend. They have routinely been, and that's despite patchwork in their center position. When you don't play LeBron and Embiid, you take out two of your top centers because LeBron is playing center.

quotes.speaker: Brian Windhorst
quotes.summary_phrase: New teams and stars typically struggle in clutch situations
quotes.excerpt: Typically, when you have a whole new team, especially new stars, you are not great in the clutch.
quotes.quote: Typically, when you have a whole new team, especially new stars, you are not great in the clutch. Typically, that is something that takes time to develop and secondly, you tend to turn the ball over a lot because your guys are learning each other. So, they are defying conventional wisdom here in that they are crushing in the clutch.

quotes.speaker: Brian Windhorst
quotes.excerpt: In 19 minutes, they are plus 22. They outscored teams by 22 minutes in clutch.

text_blocks.speaker: Brian Windhorst
text_blocks.text: I looked at their net rating and they've only played 19 clutch minutes, so we're talking, I don't want to go crazy here, but their net rating is plus 34 in clutch time.

text_blocks.speaker: Tim Bontemps
text_blocks.text: In 19 minutes, they are plus 22. They outscored teams by 22 minutes in clutch and 19 clutch minutes. So, small sample size, if you talk to basketball nerds, analytics guys, they'll tell you that clutch success early in the season is not necessarily a great indicator that this is going to be a dominant team.

quotes.speaker: Tim Bontemps
quotes.summary_phrase: Tyrese Maxey's emergence as the 76ers' best player
quotes.excerpt: Tyrese Maxey is clearly their best player and I think that's a good thing.
quotes.quote: Tyrese Maxey is clearly their best player and I think that's a good thing. He's a great closer, that helps when you talk about clutch.

quotes.speaker: Brian Windhorst
quotes.summary_phrase: Nick Nurse's offensive system and player buy-in
quotes.excerpt: Nick Nurse did a really good job of installing an offensive mindset where they're sharing the ball.
quotes.quote: Nick Nurse did a really good job of installing an offensive mindset where they're sharing the ball and so you don't have to think about who gets shots. They're just dedicated to the system and the system is producing the stuff. He was really complimentary of Nick and also the players for buying into it. It takes the players to say we know why you're doing this. But then he said, I'm watching these fourth quarters and I'm watching Jaylen Brown stand in the corner.

quotes.speaker: Brian Windhorst
quotes.summary_phrase: Jaylen Brown's role in the 76ers' late-game system
quotes.excerpt: You do wonder, is Jaylen going to be cool with this democratic, Tyrese Maxey led late game system?
quotes.quote: Watching Jaylen on the bench, he was totally engaged and excited on Friday night when they won, coming in a clutch situation. So I'm not implying anything, I'm just telling you what somebody said to me. But you do wonder, is Jaylen going to be cool with this democratic, Tyrese Maxey led late game system? They're winning now, they're winning.

quotes.speaker: Tim Bontemps
quotes.summary_phrase: Ego as a primary concern for the 76ers
quotes.excerpt: Ego is one of the primary concerns about the 76ers.
quotes.quote: Ego is one of the primary concerns about the 76ers. Is Jaylen Brown going to be okay sometimes being the third or fourth option? Is Joel Embiid going to be okay long-term being the third or fourth option? That's all part of it. I would say winning helps massage egos.

quotes.speaker: Brian Windhorst
quotes.summary_phrase: 76ers' need to address the center position
quotes.excerpt: They're going to have to do something with that center position.
quotes.quote: When you look at the 76ers, one thing that's already becoming clear is that they're going to have to do something with that center position. They've got Dewayne Dedmon started. Dewayne Dedmon is an energy player. He's not meant to play 25-30 minutes.

quotes.speaker: Tim Bontemps
quotes.summary_phrase: LeBron James' role and playing center
quotes.excerpt: LeBron James at 41 soon to be 42 is not meant to play 25 or 30 minutes.
quotes.quote: LeBron James at 41 soon to be 42 is not meant to play 25 or 30 minutes at center. He made it real clear like, hey, situationally time to time, okay, but I did not come to Philadelphia to play the five.

quotes.speaker: Brian Windhorst
quotes.summary_phrase: Anthony Simons as a key acquisition for the 76ers
quotes.excerpt: Anthony Simons, that was a really good signing.
quotes.quote: Anthony Simons, that was a really good signing. He's played probably six games and I think three of them he's been really good and three of them he hasn't done much. And I think Simons is the type of player that if you don't have to count on every single night and you can just sort of ride him when he's hot, which is the role he has here, you're going to really love him. They've been using Jabari Walker who is 6'7". They've been plugging him in, he's been competing, but that's not a solution.

quotes.speaker: Brian Windhorst
quotes.summary_phrase: 76ers' trade assets and salary cap constraints
quotes.excerpt: They do have some tradeable picks, but they don't have a lot of tradeable players.
quotes.quote: They do have some tradeable picks, but they don't have a lot of tradeable players. There's not anybody on the team you're like, oh, you can use that salary. So it wouldn't surprise me if they chill on it because Dean Wade is back now and he can play some center. But it wouldn't surprise me if they chill on it and see if there's a good center who can shake free and can sign with them later on in the year when the salary is lower and they can fit the money under the hard cap.

quotes.speaker: Tim Bontemps
quotes.summary_phrase: Joel Embiid's expected missed games due to maintenance
quotes.excerpt: Joel Embiid is going to miss many games just with the maintenance.
quotes.quote: Joel Embiid is going to miss many games just with the maintenance. Embiid's going to miss 15 to 20 games in the best case scenario.

quotes.speaker: Brian Windhorst
quotes.summary_phrase: Impact of injuries to Ariel Hukporti and Dominic Barlow
quotes.excerpt: The reason they're shallow there is because Ariel Hukporti is out for the year.
quotes.quote: The reason they're shallow there is because Ariel Hukporti is out for the year with the Achilles and Dominic Barlow, who's not really a center, but he does play big, he is out with a back injury. But I got to say, Philadelphia has got to be thrilled with the way things are gone because you can see a lot of room for improvement in the way their offense operates.

quotes.speaker: Brian Windhorst
quotes.summary_phrase: Pat Riley backing Erik Spoelstra during Miami Heat early struggles
quotes.excerpt: Riley comes in and says, you guys are doing everything right. Keep doing what you're doing.
quotes.quote: On Monday morning, the story goes, David Fizdale, who was the assistant at the time, told this story that they were in getting ready for shootaround, doing film work at 8:00 or 8:30 in the morning, and Pat Riley knocks on the door and says, hey, can I come in and talk to you guys? Fizdale said that in that moment he thought, is he coming in to fire us? The idea of Erik getting fired is laughable, but it was such a tension-filled moment. Riley comes in and says, you guys are doing everything right. I'm at practice every day. This is going to break, things are going to fall into place. Keep doing what you're doing. Basically gave them a giant shot of confidence because Riley knew, Riley could sense that there was instability. And so that's what you do as a leader, you come in there and you back up your coach.

quotes.speaker: Brian Windhorst
quotes.summary_phrase: Nick Nurse's first year as head coach in New Orleans
quotes.excerpt: I remember talking to Nick Nurse after that preseason game in New Orleans in 2019.
quotes.quote: I remember talking to Nick Nurse after that preseason game in New Orleans in 2019. It was his first year as coach. He had just been hired as head coach. He had been an assistant there. And you know, he was very, he's like, well, we'll see. He was very tentative. He wasn't taking my word for it, which I don't blame him. But you know, now he's, you know, he's got hundreds of games as a head coach in the NBA under his belt. So, but I think, you know, look, into each season a little rain will fall. The 76ers are going to have sections of the season where they probably play games they probably deserve to win and then don't. That's the nature of it. But it's been a really good start for them.
